entries.1d4f04cd86c38da6: In response to changes in the industrial structure due to EV adoption, carbon neutrality, CASE technology and other developments progressing in the automobile industry, it aims to transform without being bound by conventional business models and to establish a strong management base. As issues to be addressed with priority, it adopts the manufacture of labor-saving and manpower-saving equipment and entry into new markets not bound by machine tools or transportation equipment, and is conducting sales activities aiming to receive orders for new semiconductor manufacturing equipment and water treatment plants. In responding to globalization, it positions its Vietnam subsidiary as a base for its Southeast Asia strategy and aims to enter fields other than the transportation equipment industry and expand transactions in ASEAN.
